msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. Show the clothes on a professional female fashion model (a woman). If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. REGLA B: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia calzados-bergillos-03.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): A stylish Spanish woman in her thirties wearing beige and taupe retro running sneakers with cream wide-leg trousers and a long camel trench coat from the reference, walking at a sunny whitewashed square in Cártama, Málaga, Spain, with bougainvillea and terracotta tiles, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia calzados-bergillos-02.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): Footwear e-commerce photo of beige and taupe suede retro running sneakers with a brown stripe from the reference, a pair shown at a three-quarter angle, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEE9E2) background with a soft floor shadow, crisp leather, suede and sole detail. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia calzados-bergillos-09.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): Footwear e-commerce photo of white chunky dad sneakers with grey details from the reference, a pair shown at a three-quarter angle, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEE9E2) background with a soft floor shadow, crisp leather, suede and sole detail. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia calzados-bergillos-17.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): Footwear e-commerce photo of black knit sneakers with a gold stripe and a white platform sole from the reference, a pair shown at a three-quarter angle, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEE9E2) background with a soft floor shadow, crisp leather, suede and sole detail. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia calzados-bergillos-21.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): Footwear e-commerce photo of black suede ankle boots with a block heel and a side zip from the reference, a pair shown at a three-quarter angle, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEE9E2) background with a soft floor shadow, crisp leather, suede and sole detail.
